title: More Than Picturing the Future: Motion-Oriented Latent Reasoning for Generalizable Robot Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.29339v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent reasoning lets Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models deliberate at a fraction of the cost of explicit chain-of-thought, increasingly through visual foresight, which we show to be indispensable for predicting actions. Yet this paradigm is inherited from Vision-Language Models, where it serves understanding rather than action: each latent is aligned with an isolated future frame, often enriched with further modalities of that frame. We find that this binds the policy to the appearance of its training scenes, so that it degrades sharply once the scene changes. We argue that visual latents for action should capture not what a future frame looks like, but how the scene evolves toward the goal. We therefore propose Motion-Oriented Latent Reasoning, which redirects visual latents from the whole frame to the interaction that the action must bring about. translated_title: 不止于描绘未来：面向可泛化机器人操作的运动导向潜在推理
translated_abstract: 潜在推理使视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够以显式思维链一小部分的成本进行深思熟虑，并且越来越多地通过视觉前瞻来实现——我们证明这种视觉前瞻对于预测动作是不可或缺的。然而，这一范式继承自视觉-语言模型，在其中它服务于理解而非动作：每个潜在表示与一个孤立的未来帧对齐，并常常辅以该帧的其他模态。我们发现，这会将策略绑定到训练场景的外观上，一旦场景发生变化，策略性能就会急剧下降。我们认为，用于动作的视觉潜在表示不应捕捉未来帧“看起来像什么”，而应捕捉场景“如何朝目标演化”。为此，我们提出运动导向潜在推理，将视觉潜在表示的关注点从整个帧重定向到动作必须引发的交互上。语义潜在表示遵循具身思维链的各个阶段，首先建立……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出“运动导向潜在推理”，将VLA模型的视觉潜在表示从刻画未来帧的静态外观转向刻画场景朝目标演化的运动过程（即动作必须引发的交互），从而显著提升机器人操作策略在场景变化下的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Motion-Oriented Latent Reasoning, which redirects visual latents in VLA models from picturing the appearance of isolated future frames to capturing how scenes evolve toward the goal, substantially improving the generalization of robot manipulation policies when scenes change.
